<!-- Image with unknown copyright status removed: [[Image:Vernon-macklin-hd.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Vernon Macklin]] -->'''Vernon <!---A nickname should not go here, and according to google, both of you are wrong. It is the "Big Ticket" not Big Mac or V-Mac.--->Macklin''' (born September 25, 1986) was a player on the [[Florida Gators men's basketball]] team.  Macklin originally played for [[Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball|Georgetown]]. On May 3, 2008 it was announced that he would transfer to play at The [[University of Florida]].{{ref|Hoyasaxa}} At 6'9" and 225 pounds, Macklin was a five-star recruit at the [[power forward (basketball)|power forward]] position.{{ref|scout}}  [[Rivals.com]] ranked him as the 12th best overall player and the 3rd best [[power forward (basketball)|power forward]] in the high school class of 2006.  Macklin attended Hargrave Military Academy in [[Chatham, Virginia|Chatham]], [[Virginia]] and was named a [[McDonald's]] All-American.{{ref|mcdonalds}}  In addition, Macklin was one of only ten players selected for the 2006 [[USA Basketball]] Junior National Select Team, which participated in the [[Nike, Inc.|Nike]] Hoop Summit.{{ref|usabasketball}}
